entries.title: Live-session cancellation and connection diagnostics
fixed: Propagate cancelled requests through the hosted relay and report fixed diagnostic codes without exposing private error details.
Pairing instructions start an explicitly authorized finite live session and explain its time and usage limits.

entries.title: Experimental live AI collaboration
added: An experimental live session lets a compatible AI wait for mini-chat and board-review requests during an active conversation turn.
Live session status and Pause controls keep requests tied to the correct board and session.
fixed: Drafts remain available while an AI is busy; sending requires an actual pending wait or verified incoming-event connection.

entries.title: Retire stale experimental panel links
fixed: Previously opened panels now pause automatically instead of renewing an unverified delivery link; their saved request and receipt history stays intact.

entries.title: Verify model receipt and report automatic-chat limits
fixed: A real Claude test showed that conversation panels fill a draft without submitting it; keep automatic mini chat and board reviews unavailable until a verified incoming-message route exists.
Separate panel acknowledgement from an actual model read or reply, including older saved receipt checks.
Preserve captured request IDs and replies, block cached panels from forwarding or replaying requests, and show accurate connection availability.

entries.title: Conversation panel lifecycle checks
fixed: Hardened the experimental diagnostic panel against stale views and closing conversation windows.

entries.title: Confirmed workspace deletion and conversation diagnostics
added: Delete boards or whole projects from the workspace picker, with a named confirmation and affected-board count.
Added experimental conversation-panel diagnostics to check whether an AI app accepts text and actually starts a response.
fixed: Require an active direct-chat route before sending; preserve drafts and original request IDs when a link expires, with no per-message copy-and-paste fallback.
Revoke affected board connections before deletion, preserve unrelated work, and prevent deleted tabs from restoring removed boards.

entries.title: Clarify drawing access and saved replies
fixed: Clarified drawing edit permissions and reconnect instructions for connected AI clients.
Preserved saved conversations independently of drawing edit permission.

entries.title: Preserve unconfirmed mini-chat drafts
fixed: Keep pending text, captured context and original request IDs until a queued-delivery receipt or actual reply confirms acceptance, including connection expiry during sending.

entries.title: Clear client capabilities and verified mini chat
added: Codex and Claude Code lead the connection choices, with distinct mini-chat availability labels and website-led Claude Code setup.
fixed: Added connection checks and preserved saved requests and replies when automatic delivery is unavailable.
Used separate chat and review expiry deadlines for delivery routing, including safe retries after subscription expiry.

entries.title: Consistent UI spacing and compact layouts
fixed: Simplified AI provider choices and separated connection help from setup actions, with consistent instruction and field sizing.
Kept modal headings and close controls visible, wrapped long titles, and stacked narrow-screen action buttons.
Improved short-window canvas, object navigator, chat setup, and toolbar menus so controls stay clear of nearby elements.

entries.title: Discover events and clarify connection setup
fixed: AI clients can discover board event types after approval and before pairing; subscribing still requires pairing.
Connection errors use the selected AI flow, backup guidance uses the correct menu label, and retired helper instructions are removed from earlier changelog entries.

entries.title: Recover expired connection setup
fixed: Preparing a fresh connection recovers when the previous pending code has expired, while preserving existing access on uncertain network failures.

entries.title: Reliable message and review delivery checks
fixed: Handled chat and review event subscriptions independently, preserving safe retries when one subscription expires.
Verified message receipt only after the AI successfully reads its captured request, separately from its eventual reply.

entries.title: Consistent deployment sources
fixed: Normalized release sources for matching Windows development and Cloudflare builds, and corrected the version-recording command.

entries.title: Clearer browser connection setup
fixed: Added provider-specific setup steps inside the website and kept copied pairing instructions active when closing setup.

entries.title: Website-only AI connections
added: Connect an existing AI client through the hosted Cloudflare relay, without downloading a SharedBoard helper.
Approve board-scoped read or edit access in the browser and keep drawings, images, notes, history and chat saved locally.
Remote MCP tools read and edit the live board, review captured context, and return actual replies to the mini chat.
fixed: Retired native installers, launcher downloads and their release workflow, and rewrote historical notes for removed features.
Preserved existing browser work while separating and retiring local bridge credentials.

entries.title: Keep planning navigation in one place
fixed: Use the sidebar as the single planning navigation on desktop, while keeping panel tabs when compact or fullscreen layouts hide the sidebar.

entries.title: Compact workspace polish
fixed: Use the space freed by consolidated controls to keep the board title readable in compact windows.

entries.title: Clearer planning and conversation controls
added: Explicit handoff of saved board requests, with captured context and actual replies kept with the board.
fixed: Consolidated workspace controls and moved browser storage details into the board menu, with fullscreen and compact-screen access preserved.
Removed obsolete feature claims and the version-numbering introduction from the changelog.
Validated backup previews before rendering, protected file selection order, and corrected review context and delivery states.

entries.title: Board context and AI collaboration
added: Two-way browser mini chat, exact-revision board tools, rendered context, read/edit permissions, and browser-saved AI history with safe undo.
fixed: Reliable delivery receipts, durable retry IDs, cross-tab ownership and deadlines preserve browser data through disconnections and uncertain responses.

entries.title: Reliable board bookmarks on Cloudflare
fixed: Use the canonical root for saved-board URL rewrites so Cloudflare accepts direct board links.

entries.title: Browser beta and public source publishing
added: Browser-storage edition for static hosting: drawings, images, projects, notes, blocks, checkpoints and recovery in IndexedDB.
Cloudflare Pages build and GitHub deployment workflow, with self-contained assets, backups and browser storage controls.
Creator attribution for Andrew Barresi and public source distribution under the MIT license.
fixed: Removed publish dates from the changelog and protected browser imports and cross-tab startup updates.

entries.title: SharedBoard.app branding
fixed: Use SharedBoard.app throughout the interface, AI tools, documentation and release metadata.

entries.title: Preserve labeled shapes during AI text edits
fixed: Apply shape text changes to their visible bound labels while preserving the requested frame dimensions.
Reject stale shape edits after a person changes its label, preserve compound label edits and keep AI undo available after browser text wrapping.

entries.title: Dependency and build validation
fixed: Complete exact-version third-party notice coverage for bundled drawing components and fonts.
Reject linked first-party files before building and verify assets, dependency notices and build content hashes.

entries.title: Separate projects and clearer AI collaboration
added: Separate projects and boards with stable board addresses and independent drawings, planning, messages, history and AI connections.
Explicit mini-chat attachment previews for the board, a selection or a named area, with captured images and requirements.
An object outline and clickable minimap with naming, search, visibility, locking and layer controls.
Rolling automatic recovery saves before significant changes, with preview and restore separate from named checkpoints.
Formatted chat replies, tables, safe links, copyable code blocks, resizable chat and board-specific drafts.
A compact workspace sidebar, visible AI connection status and expanded chat that remains readable in short windows.
fixed: Board switching keeps grants and in-flight requests pinned to the original board.
Context previews and pending-review deduplication respect planning changes and empty named areas.
Renaming an unopened board persists correctly, and app shutdown also closes boards still starting.
Restore safety saves use automatic history without consuming named checkpoint slots.

entries.title: Reliable starting actions
fixed: Empty-canvas buttons receive clicks above the editor input layer.

entries.title: A workspace for real app planning
added: Named areas, project naming, board text search and a collapsible planning navigator.
Anchored notes, requirements and work cards with canvas markers and jump-to-context actions.
Pinned screenshot references, five editable planning templates and a personal reusable block library.
Named checkpoints with previews and recovery saves, plus portable .sharedboard project backups.
Rendered board images and captured visual context for AI tools, alongside immutable notes and requirements.
Contextual selection controls, grouping, alignment, duplication, locking, an alignment grid and a guided empty canvas.
fixed: AI text edits stay centered in their existing cards; editor text measurements no longer falsely block AI undo.
Drawing imports retain groups and remap frame references. Rejected stale chat sends can capture the current board on retry.

entries.title: A versioned workspace
added: A version badge and an in-app changelog accessible from the footer.
A release workflow that keeps the application version and changelog together.

entries.title: Shared editing foundation
added: A persistent canvas with shared human and AI editing, conflict detection and drawing import/export.
Sharedboard drawing controls, fullscreen, board reviews and a floating mini chat.
Guided pairing with an existing AI conversation.
